sharedRules.name: Veteran Crew
sharedRules.description: Various bonuses

sharedRules.name: Inexperienced Crew
sharedRules.description: Various malluses

sharedRules.name: Boarding Nets
sharedRules.description: Opponents suffer a -1 penalty to all grappling attempts directed against this ship.

sharedRules.name: Grappling Hooks
sharedRules.description: Add +1 to the Skill Test to grapple an opponent.

sharedRules.name: Grenades
sharedRules.description: Add +1 to the target number on all boarding actions.

sharedRules.name: Lucky
sharedRules.description: Once per game, re-roll all the dice in a single Skill Test, shooting attack or boarding action, even successful ones. You must accept the second result.

sharedRules.name: Master Carpenter
sharedRules.description: +1 to the Skill Test roll to repair damage.

sharedRules.name: Master Caulker
sharedRules.description: When attempting to repair damage, repair an extra 2 points (even if the Skill Test is failed).

sharedRules.name: Master Gunner
sharedRules.description: The first time this ship shoots in the game, it can re-roll any misses.

sharedRules.name: Over Gunned
sharedRules.description: Add +1H, +1L, to each broadside (already included in statline).

sharedRules.name: More Carronades
sharedRules.description: Add +1C to each broadside (already included in statline).

sharedRules.name: Privateer
sharedRules.description:
+2 to grapple attempts and roll 2 extra D10s, and gain +2 to
hit, in boarding actions against merchant ships.

sharedRules.name: Sharpshooters
sharedRules.description: When using musket fire, you may re-roll the Skill Test.

sharedRules.name: Ship's Surgeon
sharedRules.description: For each hit suffered during a boarding action, make a Skill Test. On a success, take no damage for that hit.

sharedRules.name: Streamlined Hull
sharedRules.description: Add 1" to the ship’s Rate of Knots the first time it moves per activation.

sharedRules.name: Swivel Guns
sharedRules.description: Before the first round of a boarding action, make a successful Skill Test to inflict 4 damage on the enemy before any further action takes place.

sharedRules.name: Trained Marines
sharedRules.description: Add +1 to the to hit target number on all boarding actions.

sharedRules.name: Regular Crew
sharedRules.description: No malluses or bonuses

sharedRules.name: Fore-and-aft rigged sails
sharedRules.description: If using the standard rules for Wind Attitude, vessels with fore-and-aft rigged sails have a +2 to the Skill Test roll when attempting to tack. If using the more realistic wind effect on movement, use the diagram on page 85 of the Hold Fast! book instead of the one in the Black Seas rulebook. Ships using fore-and-aft rigged sails also get a +1 on the Skill Test roll when attempting to tack.

sharedRules.name: Sturdy
sharedRules.description: Add 20 Ship Points to the current total (already included in statline).

sharedRules.name: Shallow Draft
sharedRules.description: Ignore the terrain rules for sandbanks and shoals/shorelines.

sharedRules.name: Moving under oars
sharedRules.description: This ship can use the "moving under oars" rules

sharedRules.name: Galleys (rule 1)
sharedRules.description: Galleys do not suffer the -2 to hit penalty whilst Moving Under Oars

sharedRules.name: Galleys (rule 2)
sharedRules.description: Furthermore, they do not have to spend a full Turn without shooting to switch from Moving Under Oars to sailing

sharedRules.name: Galleys (rule 3)
sharedRules.description: As the design of a galley was quite antiquated by the period covered by these rules, add +1 to the result when receiving a critical hit. Treat any result above 6 as a 6.

sharedRules.name: Galleys (rule 4)
sharedRules.description: Galleys were designed to ram other vessesls, therefore they do not need to test when ramming an opponent (colliding with another vessel head on). The opponent will still test to see if they can avoid the collision. The ramming Galley involved will take half (rounding up) of the damage it would normally take.

sharedRules.name: Awe and Fear
sharedRules.description: Every activation that this ship wants to engage (in any way) a ship three full ratings or more above their own will first have to pass a Skill Test. When the target is four rates above the active ship, apply -1 to the Skill Test. When five rates above, apply -2 modifier, and when six rates above, apply -3 modifier.

sharedRules.name: Added in Hold Fast!
sharedRules.description: This Navy only has national special rules, famous ships and special characters in the Hold Fast! book.

sharedRules.name: Rules of Engagement
sharedRules.description: This ship may not attack smaller ships without passing a Skill Test or unless attacked first. Every Turn in which the larger ship wishes to target its fire at a smaller vessel, it must pass a Skill Test, even if it has previously passed one for this purpose. For the purpose of this rule the Extra Large and Large ships are considered the same size.

rules.name: HMS Speedy (Rule 1)
rules.description: Enemy ships targeted for shooting must re-roll successful tests to Strike the Colours

rules.name: HMS Speedy (Rule 2)
rules.description: Boarding Actions launched from HMS Speedy have a +1 to the target number on the Boarding to Hit Table.

rules.name: HMS Surprise/Unité
rules.description: Once per game HMS Surprise can re-activate one ship within 8* that Struck the Colours. Add to the target ship enough Ship Points to return them exactly to their Break Value.

rules.name: Tonnant (Rule 1)
rules.description: The Tonnant has a +1 to hit once her Ship Points drop below half the original value

rules.name: Tonnant (Rule 2)
rules.description: When capturing ships, the Tonnant does not deduct Ship Points for the first ship captured. Instead, only add Ship Points to the captured ship as described on page 84 of Hold Fast!.

rules.name: USS Chesapeake
rules.description: Any merchant ship that tests to Strike the Colours due to being attacked by USS Cesapeake receives -1 on the test.

rules.name: L'Hermione
rules.description: Once per activation, L'Hermione can sail an extra inch

rules.name: John Paul Jones
rules.description: If the current Ship Points of Jones' ship fall below half it starting value, he and his crew can take over another ship. To do this, he declares a boarding action against any ship that has Struck the Colours. He will then command this new ship, abandoning the od one. The boarded ship's Ship Points will be reset to half their initial value.

rules.name: Cezayirli Gazi Hasan Pasha
rules.description: Once per game, each ship in Hasan Pasha's fleet may re-roll a single Skill Test

rules.name: Well Prepared (rule 1)
rules.description: Any upgrades that cost 30 points or less can be selected for free. Furthermore, upgrades that cost more than 30 points can be bought for half their value (rounding up to the nearest 10 points).

rules.name: Well Prepared (rule 2)
rules.description: A fleet may only have three of the same upgrades in total.

rules.name: Epic Battles (rule 1)
rules.description: Each player can have as many unique Special Characters and Famous Ships as they like (as long as the Dual Ownership Rule is adhered to).

rules.name: Epic Battles (rule 2)
rules.description: There are no maximum limits on which ships can be deployed.

selectionEntries.name: Famous Ships and Special Characters Only
